name: The Name-Wife's Hank
description: A hank of rush cords as thick as an arm, knotted end to end, every cord in a family's weave: the names the Name-Wife carried on her own belt, the ones she had not hung yet. One near the outside is knotted in the Nauve weave and is still green.

name: A Dyer's Tally of Weaves
description: A strip of birch-bark scratched with the knot of every family in the Delta and a count beside each.

name: The First Cord
description: A cord gone white as bone, knotted in no weave anybody uses, wound round a slip of slate with a few words scratched on it.

name: The Name-Wife's Price
description: A slate hung from the ladder at Crookstilts, written over and rubbed out and written over again.

name: The Sounder's Bell-Rope
description: A bell-rope cut through at the Sounder's hands: rush plaited with hair, black with the well's water at one end, and knotted its whole length in the bittern's loops of the Lissa weave. Read the way a watch-rope is read it says the same thing for a hundred and twenty nights: a loop, a boat; no twist; nothing came back.

name: The Callers' Tide-Table
description: A board scratched with the moon's quarters and the spring tides, a cut beside each, the last circled.

name: A Length of Knotted Rope
description: An arm's length of watch-rope tied in the Lissa knots, wound round a slip of birch-bark with the knots written out in a careful hand.

name: The Divers' Slate
description: A child's slate wedged between two of the drowned courses, scratched with names and tally-marks.

name: The Saltgate Windlass-Key
description: An iron key as long as a forearm, the Guild's tally-mark cast into its bow, for the pawl of the Saltgate's windlass. It was on the sluice-warden's ring, and the ring was on the sluice-warden, and Old Mudmouth swallowed both on the night of the flood; it came out of him green.

name: The Saltgate Watch-Book
description: The Saltgate garrison's watch-book, its boards swollen and white with salt, the ink of the last pages run in the water that came in.

name: The Sluice-Warden's Tally
description: A Guild tally-stick notched to the end and a folded page wrapped round it, pushed behind a loose stone in a wall the sluice-warden kept to himself.
